title: What It Actually Looks Like to Be the Same Man of God in the Comment Section as You Are in the Pew
caption:
Nobody in that thread knows your name. That's exactly why it shows your real one.

A man of God doesn't get an anonymous personality. The words that would embarrass you at a dinner table don't get to exist in a comment box either, and the argument you're winning isn't worth the man you're becoming to win it.

Say it like he'd hear it. Then log off before you log the win.

#faith #christianmen #manofgod #integrity #onlinebehavior
